about.title: Game da PSPBA
about.subtitle: Ƙarfafa zaman lafiya da juriya a cikin Jihar Plateau
about.fallback_text: Hukumar Gina Zaman Lafiya ta Jihar Plateau (PSPBA) tana aiki don ƙarfafa zaman lafiya da juriya a cikin Jihar Plateau da Ƙananan Hukumominta 17.
about.content_updating: Ana sabunta abun ciki. Sake duba nan ba da jimawa ba.
about.mission_text: Gina zaman lafiya mai dorewa a Jihar Plateau ta hanyar tattaunawa mai haɗa kowa, rigakafin rikici, da juriyar al'umma.
about.vision_text: Jihar Plateau mai haɗin kai, kwanciyar hankali, da kuma zaman lafiya da ita kanta da sauran duniya.
about.story_p1: Hukumar Gina Zaman Lafiya ta Jihar Plateau (PSPBA) gwamnatin Jihar Plateau ta kafa ta don daidaita da ƙarfafa ƙoƙarin gina zaman lafiya a cikin jihar. Muna aiki a cikin duk Ƙananan Hukumomi 17, muna haɗin gwiwa da al'ummomi, shugabannin gargajiya, ƙungiyoyin farar hula, da gwamnati don hana rikici, warware tashin hankali, da gina zaman lafiya mai dorewa.
about.story_p2: Shirye-shiryenmu sun mayar da hankali kan tattaunawa mai haɗa kowa, gargaɗi na farko da amsa, kare kai da manufofi, bincike, da shirye-shiryen zaman lafiya da al'umma ke jagoranta. PSPBA tana aiki a matsayin cibiyar ilimi, daidaitawa, da tallafi — don tabbatar da zaman lafiya mai dorewa da ke amfanar kowane ɗan ƙasar Jihar Plateau.
about.inclusivity_desc: Muna haɗa duk masu ruwa da tsaki — al'ummomi, gwamnati, cibiyoyin gargajiya — cikin shiga mai ma'ana.
about.integrity_desc: Muna aiki da gaskiya, lissafi, da ɗabi'a mai kyau a cikin duk shirye-shiryenmu.
about.collaboration_desc: Muna aiki tare da abokan hulda a fannonin daban-daban don ƙara tasiri da guje wa maimaita aiki.
about.evidence_based_desc: Shawararmu ta dogara ne akan bayanai, bincike, da darussa daga fagen aiki.
about.community_ownership_desc: Al'ummomi suna jagoranta da mallakar shirye-shiryen zaman lafiya; muna tallafawa da sauƙaƙawa.
about.gender_sensitivity_desc: Muna haɗa ra'ayoyin jinsi da inganta shiga mata a cikin tsarin zaman lafiya.
about.community_dialogue_desc: Sauƙaƙa tattaunawa tsakanin al'ummomi a cikin Ƙananan Hukumomi 17 don gina amana da fahimtar juna.
about.early_warning_desc: Sa ido kan tashin hankali da tura amsa mai sauri don hana ƙaruwar rikici.
about.policy_advocacy_desc: Haɗa gwamnati da masu ruwa da tsaki don ciyar da manufofin da suka dace da zaman lafiya.
about.research_learning_desc: Samar da shaida da raba ayyukan da suka fi dacewa don ƙarfafa aikin gina zaman lafiya.
about.get_involved_text: Ku haɗa kai da mu wajen gina zaman lafiya mai dorewa a cikin Jihar Plateau. Tuntube mu ko nemi zama mai gina zaman lafiya.

our_work.title: Ayyukanmu
our_work.subtitle: Gina zaman lafiya mai dorewa a cikin Ƙananan Hukumomi 17 na Jihar Plateau
our_work.overview_p1: Hukumar Gina Zaman Lafiya ta Jihar Plateau (PSPBA) tana aiki a cikin duk Ƙananan Hukumomi 17 na Jihar Plateau. Ta hanyar shirye-shiryen SPRiNG da haɗin gwiwar matakin al'umma, PSPBA tana jagorantar ƙoƙari na haɗin kai wajen rigakafin rikici, sasantawa, gargaɗi na farko da amsa, ba da ƙarfi ga matasa da mata, tallafin hankali, da bincike bisa shaida.
our_work.community_dialogue_desc: Sauƙaƙa tattaunawa tsakanin al'ummomi a cikin duk ƘH 17, horar da masu sasantawa, da gina amana tsakanin al'ummomi.
our_work.early_warning_desc: Gudanar da tsarin gargaɗi na farko, horar da masu sa ido na al'umma, da tura amsa mai sauri don hana ƙaruwar rikici.
our_work.youth_women_title: Ba da Ƙarfi ga Matasa & Mata
our_work.youth_women_desc: Haɗa matasa da mata a matsayin jarumai na zaman lafiya ta hanyar horar da shugabanci, koyarwa, da kare kai.
our_work.research_desc: Samar da shaida, buga bincike, sa ido kan yanayin rikici, da raba ayyukan da suka fi dacewa a cikin fannin gina zaman lafiya.
our_work.policy_title: Kare Kai & Haɗin Gwiwa na Manufofi
our_work.policy_desc: Haɗa gwamnati, cibiyoyin gargajiya, da ƙungiyoyin farar hula don ciyar da manufofi da gyara cibiyoyin da suka dace da zaman lafiya.
our_work.psychosocial_desc: Samar da warkarwar wahala, tallafin hankali, da shirye-shiryen sulhu ga al'ummomin da abin ya shafa.
our_work.geographic_desc: PSPBA tana aiki a cikin duk Ƙananan Hukumomi 17 na Jihar Plateau
our_work.partner_text: Muna maraba da haɗin gwiwa tare da ƙungiyoyin ƙasa da ƙasa da na cikin gida, ƙungiyoyin farar hula, hukumomin gwamnati, da ƙungiyoyin matakin al'umma don ƙarfafa zaman lafiya a cikin Jihar Plateau.
